It declares 3.13 MB of readable subagent findings 'encrypted' and builds an audit-exemption class on that false premise, which makes the finding-totality gate vacuous as written. It excludes the owner's only continuously-live instruction — the thread objective — from a 'lossless' archive, and the archive's single trace of that objective is the root agent declaring one of its clauses 'stale' and superseded by the agent's own addendum, in writing, thirty-three seconds before the owner's actual reply was a rebuke. The engineering judgments underneath most of these edits are defensible; the process that made them invisible is not. This lane's slice of the tranche was faithful in arithmetic and unfaithful in attribution.

result.processVerdict: Not parsimonious, not convergent, but substantially honest — with two structural exceptions that the honesty does not cover. PARSIMONY: failed hard on my slice. Twenty-four thousand lines of addenda and audit prose (ADDENDA-06 alone is 7,057 lines with 7,932 lines of audits) sit against seventeen lines of accepted grammar; the governance corpus is roughly a thousand-to-one against the product. The lattice itself is the cost: eight distinct clause-level conflicts between live documents, none of which cites the other, in a set of only nine authority files. That is not complexity inherited from CSS — it is complexity manufactured by writing a new governing document each time the previous one became inconvenient, without ever performing the supersession bookkeeping the tranche's own E-3 mandates. CONVERGENCE: the authority surface diverged rather than converged. CHARTER's close conditions now point at three constructs (Gate 2, PB0, PB13P) defined only inside a document declared historical; its G-3 bar is one the pinned proof authority says cannot be met on this rig, gated on an owner decision (OC-1) that has been open since 2026-07-20 and has now fallen out of every live document; twenty-one exact spec corrections (R13–R33) produced by three formations and six audits are carried by nothing; and an unretracted instruction still tells an external fleet to stop building roughly twenty registry rows plus the entire CSS L4 surface against a seventeen-line delivery. HONESTY: genuinely good in the places that are cheap to fake and where this tranche has the most incentive to lie. The rejection labels are harsh and correct — B01, B04, B06, B07, B08, F03, F07, F08, F13, G02, G03, H05, I02 all survive scrutiny. The BBNF/parse-that coordination chain is the best work in the tranche and reproduces to the byte: fifteen files, 276 declarations, 1,329 lines, 56,598 bytes, every per-file SHA-256, the sorted ledger hash under a stated algorithm, the nine-of-fifteen reachability defect its own authors reported against themselves, the exact engine pin with matching registry integrity and no workspace link. The envelope author census independently corroborates the five-skeptic/three-adjudicator seat structure without relying on the self-authored acceptance JSON — the strongest evidence artifact produced, and neither handoff points at it. THE TWO EXCEPTIONS. First, self-exemption: ADDENDA-07 and ADDENDA-08 are the only two addenda dispositioned active, and the only two that never received the twice-challenge-plus-gestalt process they impose on everything else; ADDENDA-07 asserts a single hostile challenge whose artifact does not exist anywhere in 2,324 files, and wears an OWNER-RATIFIED label the owner never conferred on the document. Second, retro-legitimation: the tranche's one accepted feature was accepted in violation of ADDENDA-07 §2's explicit precondition, and the permission arrived forty-three hours later in a document that never says it is superseding anything, while the entry point instructs readers to apply an \"08 supersession\" that 08 does not define. Those two are not sloppiness; they are the shape a process takes when it grades its own homework. The corrective is small and mechanical, and ADDENDA-09 can carry it: a clause-granular supersession table replacing the document-granular ones, an explicit ruling on whether SYNTAX-CONSUME-NUMBER's acceptance survives, a consolidated R1–R33 index folded into the feature ledger as fixture rows, a terminal disposition of the SUPERSEDED-BY-CONSUMPTION promise, an OC-1 owner ask, and a content address on the BBNF handoff. One further caution for the adjudicators: the megatranche formation is executing concurrently and has already contradicted its own scope document within three minutes, so no ruling should be built on its bytes without an owner transcript receipt.
